caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, rendered in black and gray pencil on a cream or off-white background. The bonnet occupies most of the central portion of the image and is detailed with intricate floral patterns featuring leaves and round flowers distributed evenly across its surface. The bonnet is outlined with fine lines and light shading is used to create depth and texture. There is a string or tie attached at the bottom left corner of the bonnet, extending outwards towards the lower left side of the image. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the bonnet. Two inscriptions are visible: one in the upper right corner and one near the lower right corner reading "GRACE HALPIN."
title: Infant's Cap
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
